verdict.rationale: The project's own RELEASE-NOTES.md shows ongoing releases: new harness support (Devin CLI, Hermes Agent, Grok Build CLI), an Antigravity Marketplace manifest, and many workflow fixes. A community comment also notes a recent update changed self-review behavior. That covers the 'recent releases' part only; nothing in the pack addresses issue triage or accepted community contributions, and no release dates or cadence are given. missing for 10: evidence of issue triage, evidence of merged community contributions, dated release cadence, independent corroboration of maintenance activity.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection is actively maintained — recent releases, triaged issues, and accepted community contributions

citations.quote: Grok Build CLI added to the install docs.
This release also adds a native plugin manifest for the Antigravity Marketplace
Devin CLI: `devin plugins install obra/superpowers` now works, and skills auto-trigger at session start.
Worktree removal no longer destroys untracked files.
A recent update removed the subagents for self-review; the self-review now happens in the main agent.
